summary: Iteration 4: Verified admin seeding + /api/ads CRUD + public /api/ads/active. New test file test_admin_ads.py = 35/35 PASS. Regression test_nounou.py + test_new_features.py = 78/78 PASS (one transient network timeout in full run recovered on retry). Total 113 backend tests green.

test_results.TestAdminSeed: PASS 3/3 - admin +2250100000000/Admin1234 login returns role=admin; /auth/me confirms role; register with role=admin -> 422 (Pydantic Literal)
test_results.TestAdsCreate: PASS 8/8 - 401 unauth; 403 for parent & nounou; admin creates home/pre_contact/inactive ads; 422 on invalid placement & missing title
test_results.TestAdsList: PASS 3/3 - GET /api/ads: 401 unauth, 403 parent, 200 admin lists all; no _id leaks

critical_code_review_comments: seed_admin correctly updates role and password when env values changed (server.py:741-745), and uses normalize_phone before DB ops. Good.
require_admin dependency (server.py:653) cleanly centralizes RBAC for /api/ads endpoints.
GET /api/ads/active is public as intended - no auth required. Safe for frontend pre-login consumption.
AdUpdateIn empty body correctly raises 400 (server.py:679-680) instead of silently no-op.
Minor: /api/ads/active takes placement as free-form string (not Literal); invalid placements silently return empty list. Not a bug, but could reject with 422 for consistency with POST.
Minor: no pagination on /api/ads (capped at 200) and /api/ads/active (capped at 50). Acceptable for MVP scale.
Pre-existing: put_object/get_object still use sync `requests` inside async handlers (already flagged in iteration_3). Not in scope for this iteration.
Observed: one 15s TCP connect timeout to preview URL during regression burst (network-layer, not app). Tests with long chains benefit from requests.Session + retry adapter.

success_rate.backend: 100% (113/113 on retry; 112/113 first pass due to transient network timeout)
